intro: N-up arranges several PDF pages side by side on a single sheet — 2, 4, 6, 9, or 16 per page — so you can print handouts, thumbnails, or drafts with far less paper. Your original pages stay intact; they're just scaled down and tiled onto larger sheets. It's free, needs no signup, and your file is processed privately and auto-deleted within 24 hours.
steps: Drop your PDF into the box above
Choose how many pages to fit per sheet — 2, 4, 6, 9, or 16-up
Run it and your N-up PDF downloads automatically, ready to print

faqs.q: What does N-up actually do?
faqs.a: It places multiple pages of your PDF onto one larger sheet, shrinking each page to fit. A 4-up layout puts 4 pages on a single sheet in a grid. Nothing is deleted — it's a print-friendly arrangement, ideal for handouts, proofs, and saving paper and ink.

faqs.q: How many pages can I fit on one sheet?
faqs.a: You can choose 2, 4, 6, 9, or 16 pages per sheet. More pages per sheet means each one is scaled smaller, so 2-up or 4-up stays comfortably readable while 16-up is best for thumbnails and overviews.

faqs.q: Is the N-up tool free and do I need an account?
faqs.a: Yes, it's completely free with no ads and no signup. You can use it anonymously with limits of 25MB, 500 pages, and 10 jobs per day; signing in raises those limits.

faqs.q: Are my files kept private?
faqs.a: Yes. Your PDF is processed privately, never used for ads or tracking, and automatically deleted within 24 hours, with a zero-retention option available. Papyrus is also open-source and self-hostable.

title: PDF to PowerPoint (PPTX) — Papyrus
metaDescription: Convert PDF to an editable PowerPoint (.pptx) online, free with no signup. Private processing, no ads, and your files auto-delete within 24 hours.
intro: Turn a PDF into a PowerPoint presentation you can open and edit in PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides. Papyrus maps each PDF page to a slide, and it's free, needs no signup, and keeps your file private — deleted within 24 hours.
steps: Drop your PDF into the box above
Click Convert to PowerPoint
Download the .pptx and open it in PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides

faqs.q: Is converting PDF to PowerPoint free?
faqs.a: Yes. PDF to PowerPoint conversion on Papyrus is free with no ads and no signup. Anonymous users can convert files up to 25MB and 500 pages, with up to 10 jobs a day.

faqs.q: Will the slides be fully editable?
faqs.a: It depends on the PDF. Clean, text-based pages come through with editable text you can rework in PowerPoint. Complex or heavily designed pages may arrive as a full-page image per slide rather than editable text, so treat those slides as pictures you can crop or annotate but not retype.

faqs.q: Is it private and safe?
faqs.a: Yes. Your file is processed privately, we never log its contents, and it's automatically deleted within 24 hours, with a zero-retention option available. Papyrus is also open-source and self-hostable if you'd rather run it yourself.

faqs.q: Do I need an account?
faqs.a: No. You can convert a PDF to PowerPoint anonymously with no signup. Anonymous use is capped at 25MB, 500 pages, and 10 jobs per day, and signing in raises those limits.

faqs.q: Can I convert a scanned PDF to PowerPoint?
faqs.a: You can, but scanned or image-only pages have no selectable text, so each slide will be an image. Run our OCR tool first if you need the text to be editable, then convert.

title: Edit or Remove PDF Metadata — Papyrus
metaDescription: Edit or strip PDF metadata online, free and private. Change Title, Author, Subject, and Keywords or wipe them clean. No signup, no account, files auto-delete.
intro: Every PDF carries hidden details behind the scenes — the author name, the software that made it, and creation and modification timestamps that you may not want to share. Papyrus lets you edit the Title, Author, Subject, and Keywords or strip that hidden information entirely before you send the file on. It's free, needs no account, and your upload is deleted automatically within 24 hours.
steps: Drop your PDF onto the page — no signup, up to 25MB and 500 pages.
Edit the Title, Author, Subject, and Keywords fields, or clear them to remove the hidden metadata.
Download the cleaned PDF, which is deleted from our servers within 24 hours.

faqs.q: Is it free?
faqs.a: Yes. Editing and removing PDF metadata is completely free, with no ads and no watermarks. Anonymous users can run up to 10 jobs a day on files up to 25MB and 500 pages.

faqs.q: Is it private and safe?
faqs.a: Yes. Papyrus is built privacy-first: your file is used only to process your request and is deleted automatically within 24 hours. That's the whole point of this tool — stripping the hidden author, software, and timestamp details before you share a document.

faqs.q: Do I need an account?
faqs.a: No. You can drop a file and edit or remove its metadata straight away without signing up. Papyrus is also open source and self-hostable if you'd rather run it yourself.

faqs.q: Which metadata fields can I change?
faqs.a: You can edit the standard document fields — Title, Author, Subject, and Keywords — or clear them so no author or descriptive information remains in the file.

faqs.q: Can I fully remove hidden information before sharing?
faqs.a: Yes. Clear the metadata fields and the visible Title, Author, Subject, and Keywords are stripped, so the details you don't want to share don't travel with the PDF.
